en.help:
Commands (/claude-pet:pet <command>)
  status              status (default)
  stats               stats (today / total)
  achievements        achievement list
  feed / play         feed / play
  trick <name>        tricks: {tricks}
  say <text>          make it say something
  timer <min> [label] pomodoro; timer off to cancel; timer to check
  name <name>         rename
  skin pixel|chibi    switch skin
  color <color>       chibi color: {colors}
  hat <accessory>     accessory: {accs}
  lang en|zh-TW|auto  language
  show / hide         bring out / put away the pet
  autostart on|off    bring out the pet when Claude Code starts
  settings            show all settings
  doctor              check the setup when the pet doesn't appear
  {toggles} on|off
  break <min>|off     break reminder interval (default 60)
